messages.subject: Notes: Leadership meeting 28 May
messages.body:
Liebe Alle,

Notes: Leadership meeting, Thursday 28 May, 14:00, meeting room Rotterdam

Attendees: Marta, Dev, Helen, Priya, Tomás, Lena (notes)

Discussed:
- Ledgerly cutover: Dev reported the reconciliation rewrite is done and the last two full sandbox cycles reconciled cleanly, including refunds and multi-currency. Jonas confirmed independently. Helen asked whether we could still make 1 July; Dev recommended after the June 30 billing close instead, so the first live settlement cycle starts from a closed ledger. 1 July would mean switching mid-cycle and partially reconciled June books.
- v3 rollout: phased rollout completed on schedule, 100% of accounts live since 27 May. No payment-related incidents so far.
- Office sublet: two interested parties, viewings next week

Agreed:
- Ledgerly cutover is fixed for Monday 6 July, after the June 30 billing close. Marta confirmed in the meeting. Dev to circulate the final plan.
- No further changes to the payments timeline without Marta and Dev both agreeing.

Actions:
- Dev: send the confirmed cutover plan to Helen and Jonas
- Aisha: prepare the customer communication for the card-statement change (draft due 10 July)
- Lena: book the war room for 6-7 July

Danke,
Lena Fischer
Ops & Office Manager, Parcelwise B.V.

messages.subject: RE: Notes: Leadership meeting 28 May
messages.body:
Dear Marta, dear Dev,

Thank you Lena for the notes. One point of clarification so my model matches reality: with cutover on Monday 6 July, July will be the first full month processed entirely through Ledgerly, and we should see the approximately €1,860 monthly saving reflected from that month's books onward. If the numbers deviate materially from that figure in July or August I will want to know why, so please do keep the fee reporting granular by provider during the transition.

I would also gently remind everyone that PayForge will keep charging their minimum platform fee until we formally terminate - Dev, please include the notice period in the plan so we are not paying two platforms a day longer than necessary.

Kind regards,
Helen Oyelaran
Chief Financial Officer, Parcelwise B.V.
